posts.name: muktinath-or-kailash
posts.question: Which yatra comes first?
posts.caption:
Two of the holiest journeys in the Himalaya. Which one is calling you first? 🙏

🅰️ Muktinath — 6 days from Kathmandu. Fly through the Kali Gandaki gorge to Jomsom, then a short jeep ride to the temple at 3,800 m for darshan and puja among the 108 sacred water spouts and the eternal flame of Jwala Mai. No long trek, so it suits families and older devotees.

🅱️ Mount Kailash — 13 days across the Tibetan plateau to Lake Mansarovar, then the three-day parikrama of about 52 km over the Dolma-La Pass (5,630 m). From USD 1,750 per person. We arrange the Tibet group visa (minimum 5 people) and every permit.

One is gentle, one is the journey of a lifetime — both private to your family or group, with an experienced guide.

Comment A or B 👇 and tell us who you would travel with.

posts.name: langtang-valley-trek
posts.title: Langtang Valley Trek
posts.subtitle: Syabrubesi › Langtang Village › Kyanjin Gompa, 3,870 m
posts.price_line: Private trek · Ask for your price
posts.caption:
No mountain flight needed: this valley of glaciers starts a day's drive from Kathmandu. 🏔️

The trailhead at Syabrubesi is about 7–8 hours by road, which makes Langtang Nepal's closest major trek to the capital. Our 10-day Langtang Valley Trek:

🌲 Day 3 — through forest to Lama Hotel (2,480 m)
🏡 Day 4 — Langtang Village (3,430 m), rebuilt by its community after the 2015 earthquake
🛕 Day 5 — Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m), below the Langtang Lirung glacier
⛰️ Day 6 — optional climb of Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,984 m)

Private to your group, with a government-licensed guide, porters, teahouses, and the Langtang National Park permit and TIMS card included.

reels.caption:
One full loop around the world's eighth-highest mountain. 🏔️

The Manaslu Circuit circles Manaslu (8,163 m): up the river gorges from Soti Khola, through Tibetan-influenced villages to Samagaon (3,530 m) for an acclimatisation day, then a pre-dawn start over the Larkya La (5,160 m) and down to Bimthang. Far quieter than Annapurna or Everest. 16 days, challenging, no technical climbing — private to your group, with the restricted-area permit, a licensed guide and porters included.

Could you do the 2 am start for the Larkya La? 👇

Everest has two sides. This is the quieter one. 🏔️

Our North Face expedition follows the route Mallory and Irvine attempted in 1924: overland from Kathmandu across the Tibetan plateau via Nyalam and Tingri, to Rongbuk Base Camp (5,154 m) and Advanced Base Camp (6,400 m), then the North Col and the Northeast Ridge. There is no Khumbu Icefall on this side.

60 days, for experienced climbers only — previous summits of 7,000–8,000 m are required. We handle the Tibet permits (subject to Chinese government approval, so apply about 12 months ahead), with Sherpa support and full base-camp setup. Private to your team.
